主要内容: On April 16, 2013, Optical Cable Corporation (the Company or OCC®) issued a press release announcing that the Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.02 per share on the Companys common stock effective April 15, 2013. The Companys Board of Directors declared that the dividend would be paid on or about May 15, 2013 to shareholders of record on April 29, 2013.
